post.description: Tiers in relevance order: exact, phrasal, starts-with, phrases, ends-with, contains. When none matches, a trigram similarity tier answers typos (`meta.fuzzy: true`, `similarity` on every item; Postgres instances only). A term shorter than 3 characters searches the exact and prefix tiers only (`meta.short_term: true`).

info.description: Read-only dictionary API under /api/v1 (contract version 1): no authentication, every answer in a { data, meta } envelope, errors as { statusCode, message, error: true }, X-API-Version on every response. Successful GET answers carry ETag, Last-Modified and Cache-Control. See docs/api.md in the repository.
